evidence_scope: source-validation only; no outcome subject performance and no WBCIC S2/S3 utility

diagnosis.WBCIC: The source-only cache after the metadata-declared x20 transform had median absolute amplitude 0.00311 uV and q99 0.03308 uV, approximately 1000x below physiological scale. This demonstrates a metadata/cache unit mismatch.
diagnosis.CBraMod: Official mean pooling was loadable but source-validation BA remained 0.50-0.52. The official BCIC-IV-2a release defaults to the all_patch_reps downstream classifier and a separate higher downstream learning rate.

repair.WBCIC_unit_transform: cache x 20000 = microvolts (metadata x20 plus audited 1000x correction), then retain the historical intended [-250,250] microvolt artifact bound; expected source-only q99 approximately 33 uV
repair.CBraMod_downstream: official all_patch_reps projector: flatten final tokens -> Linear(C*4*200,800) -> ELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(800,200) -> ELU -> Dropout(0.1) -> Linear(200,2)
repair.primary_CBraMod_representation: fixed 200-D penultimate vector of the official downstream projector
repair.optimizer: official multi-LR: searched encoder LR and downstream LR 0.001*sqrt(batch/256)
